exposure: Occurrence of prelabor rupture of membranes
cohort: Fifty-four patients with singleton gestations, diagnosis of prelabor rupture of membranes (PROM), and gestational age between 24 and 38 weeks and 6 days were included.
finding: The QuantusFLM(r) method predicted NRM with 60% sensitivity, 79.5% specificity, 40% positive predictive value, 89.7% negative predictive value, and 75.6% accuracy in patients with PROM.
cross-section timing: Fetal lung image was acquired by ultrasound within 48 hours prior to delivery.
gest_age: Inclusion criteria: between 24 and 38 weeks and 6 days. Mean gestational age at delivery was 35 weeks and 4 days.
